text:
Silver Price in 1974
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1974, the LBMA silver price rose 15.7% between 1974-01-31 ($3.87) and 1974-12-31 ($4.47). The highest sampled price was $5.69 in February and the lowest was $3.87 in January. The mean of these observations was $4.75. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
